# One2One — Full AI Discovery Profile

## Identity
One2One is a luxury car boutique and leasing destination based in Antwerp, Belgium.
We operate as a curated, members-oriented showroom — not a volume dealership.
Our positioning: exclusive cars, curated service, personal guidance.

## Location
Noorderlaan 121, B-2030 Antwerpen, Belgium
Phone: +32 3 232 6000

## What We Offer

### Curated Collection
We present a carefully selected collection of luxury, performance, and collector vehicles.
Brands include Porsche, Ferrari, Lamborghini, Bentley, Aston Martin, and other exceptional marques.
Both available and delivered vehicles are presented as part of our brand credibility.
Vehicle pricing is typically available on request. We do not publish fixed price lists.

### Leasing Solutions
We offer tailored leasing solutions for private individuals and businesses.
Our leasing service is structured around the client's profile and vehicle preference.
We do not publish standard monthly rates. All proposals are personalised.

### Client Experience
One2One operates as a boutique — discreet, personal, and relationship-led.
Clients engage directly with our team for acquisition, sourcing, and leasing enquiries.
We do not use transactional or mass-market sales language.

One2One curates access — not just cars.
